chapter: Setting the record straight on Hendersonia
title: The Hendersonia author and a union fine Horace denies
summary: Horace was not asked for permission to publish Hendersonia, resents the author approaching his sister, and challenges the claim that he was fined by Local 802 for working under scale.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Okay. Well, we can -- I don't have a copy of the book. Do you have a copy of the book?

I did have a copy of the book. There was one here in the library. This gentleman that published this book wrote me several months -- when I say several months, I mean a lot of months ago -- and wanted my permission to -- two, three years ago this was -- to publish this book. I didn't give the permission. So he went down South where my sister is living, and I understand he tried to romance her to get her permission, and of course she never does anything without checking with me. She didn't give it. I've checked with her. So where he got the authority to publish this book without our permission, I don't know. The only letter
I've gotten since this book was out is if I wanted the book, I could send him $10.00, and he'd send me one. Which is a great thing.

He made a couple of remarks in there about me that I'm going to challenge also, from 802. He said that I was playing a job in Harlem somewhere under the scale, and I was taken before the board. I'm going to challenge that too.
In fact it's right at the top of this page.
I'm not at all pleased with that.
Page 211, right at the very top, it says-- he covered himself by stating 'Horace was reportedly brought up before the local 802 board for accepting less than scale and was fined by the union.'
Huh. That I'm really going to challenge.
That it was the first thing I saw in that book, and I became really a little upset about it. We're going to really check -- my attorney's going to check into quite a few of these things.
